reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Centella Sunflower Makeup Melting Cleansing Balm 100g
reviews.text: This is a fantastic makeup remover, what makes it stand out to me is the texture is a balm but it melts into the skin like an oil and it’s not irritating my eyes if I use it to remove mascara. The packaging is perfect because it will not leak which is important when I travel. My sensitive skin has never had any irritation to this cleansing balm and therefore I will keep purchasing it!
reviews.zh: 呢款卸妝產品真係超正，最吸引我嘅係佢係膏狀質地，但接觸到皮膚就會好似油一樣溶化，用佢卸睫毛液都唔會刺激到眼。包裝亦好好，唔會漏，呢點對我出嚟去好重要。我敏感肌用咗都從未試過有任何刺激，一定會繼續回購！

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Centella Sunflower Makeup Melting Cleansing Balm 100g
reviews.text:
何が合わないのかはわかりませんでしたが私は翌日に少し乾燥を感じてしまいました。
（当方超乾燥肌です）
その分洗浄力はしっかりしているため
混合肌・普通〜ちょい乾燥肌ぐらいの方が使うと合うのかな？と思いました！
reviews.zh:
雖然唔知邊度夾唔到我，但用咗第二日皮膚有少少乾燥嘅感覺。
（我係超乾肌）
不過清潔力係夠嘅，所以
可能比較適合混合肌或者普通至略乾嘅肌膚用？

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Centella Sunflower Makeup Melting Cleansing Balm 100g
reviews.text: Este limpiadora es un balsamo que ayuda a remover todos los residuos de maquillaje protector solar, es muy efectivo, no genera irritación en la piel. Esta marca es muy buena. La calidad del producto y del empaque son increíbles. Lo recomiendo.
reviews.zh: 呢款卸妝產品係一款可以幫助清除所有化妝品同防曬殘留嘅膏狀產品，非常有效，唔會刺激皮膚。呢個品牌好正。產品同包裝嘅質素都好得難以置信。推薦畀大家。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Centella Sunflower Makeup Melting Cleansing Balm 100g
reviews.text:
Haruharu Wonder Centella Sunflower Makeup-Melting Cleansing Balm is a highly effective and gentle first-step cleanser suitable for most skin types. Its nourishing formula and ability to remove makeup without irritation make it a standout product in the K-beauty cleansing category.

Effective Makeup Removal: Users report that the balm efficiently removes heavy makeup, including waterproof formulas, leaving the skin clean without the need for a second cleanse. 

Gentle on Skin: The balm is praised for its gentle formulation, making it suitable for all skin types, including sensitive skin. It does not cause irritation or dryness.
reviews.zh:
Haruharu Wonder Centella Sunflower Makeup-Melting Cleansing Balm 係一款高效而且溫和嘅第一步清潔產品，適合大部分膚質。佢滋潤嘅配方同能夠卸妝同時唔刺激嘅特點，令佢喺韓系卸妝類別中脫穎而出。

高效卸妝：用家反映呢款卸妝膏能夠有效卸除濃妝，包括防水配方，用完之後皮膚乾淨，唔需要再洗多一次。

溫和親膚：呢款卸妝膏嘅溫和配方備受讚譽，適合所有膚質，包括敏感肌。唔會引起刺激或乾燥。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Centella Sunflower Makeup Melting Cleansing Balm 100g
reviews.text: Um produto maravilhoso, estou adorando. Limpa e hidrata a pele na medida certa. Remove toda a maquiagem com uma pequena quantidade do produto.
reviews.zh: 呢款產品好正，我用得好開心。清潔同保濕皮膚嘅程度啱啱好。只需要少量就可以徹底卸走所有妝容。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Centella Sunflower Makeup Melting Cleansing Balm 100g
reviews.text: Finally got to try this cleansing balm! I like it more than the cleansing oil. It has a subtle smell, but it's manageable. It takes off make up and sunscreen well and melts on my skin.
reviews.zh: 終於試到呢款卸妝膏！我覺得佢比卸妝油更加好用。有淡淡嘅氣味，但都仲接受得到。妝同防曬都卸得乾淨，而且喺皮膚上好容易就溶化。

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Centella Sunflower Makeup Melting Cleansing Balm 100g
reviews.text: It effectively removes makeup and sunscreen, leaving skin feeling soft, hydrated, and comfortable without a greasy residue. Recommends!
reviews.zh: 佢可以有效卸除妝容同防曬，用完皮膚感覺柔軟、保濕、舒適，唔會留低油笠殘留。推薦！

reviews.shade: Haruharu wonder Centella Sunflower Makeup Melting Cleansing Balm 100g
reviews.text: This cleansing balm combines nourishing sunflower oil with soothing centella asiatica to gently dissolve makeup and impurities. It has a smooth, buttery texture that melts upon contact with the skin, transforming into a silky oil that rinses off cleanly without residue. The formula is designed to be non-irritating, making it a solid option for sensitive skin types. Beyond cleansing, it leaves the skin feeling soft and hydrated, so it doesn’t strip away natural oils while effectively removing even waterproof products.
reviews.zh: 呢款卸妝膏結合滋潤嘅向日葵油同舒緩嘅積雪草，可以溫和咁溶解妝容同雜質。質地順滑好似牛油，接觸到皮膚就會融化，變成絲滑嘅油，可以沖洗得乾乾淨淨冇殘留。配方設計成唔會刺激，係敏感肌嘅穩陣選擇。除咗清潔之外，用完皮膚仲會感覺柔軟同保濕，所以唔會抽乾肌膚天然油脂，同時仲可以有效卸除防水產品。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
